title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named destinations along the 19th Street corridor beside or within the practical orbit of Texas Tech University.

cards.title: Skyviews Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 19th Street and University Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Reserve a table at the Texas Tech Plaza building’s top-floor teaching restaurant, located at the southeast corner of 19th and University.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent restaurant operated through Texas Tech’s hospitality program.
cards.evidence_claim: Texas Tech identifies Skyviews as a top-floor restaurant at 1901 University Avenue, on the southeast corner of University Avenue and 19th Street adjacent to campus.
cards.access_notes: Lunch service is listed for fall and spring semesters when classes are in session; dinner events require reservations.

cards.title: Buddy Holly Center
cards.subtitle: 19th Street and Crickets Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Visit the historic depot at 1801 Crickets Avenue to see exhibits about Buddy Holly, West Texas music, and contemporary visual art.
cards.short_summary: A City of Lubbock cultural center in a renovated historic depot.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lubbock says the Buddy Holly Center preserves and interprets Buddy Holly and West Texas music artifacts and presents contemporary visual-art exhibitions.
cards.source_title: Buddy Holly Center | City of Lubbock
cards.access_notes: The City lists the Center at 1801 Crickets Avenue, at the northeast corner of 19th Street and Crickets Avenue.

cards.entity_name: Buddy and Maria Elena Holly Plaza
cards.title: Buddy and Maria Elena Holly Plaza
cards.subtitle: 19th Street and Crickets Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the plaza west of the Buddy Holly Center to view the West Texas Walk of Fame and Grant Speed’s Buddy Holly statue.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor public plaza with a documented music-history landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lubbock places the West Texas Walk of Fame and Buddy Holly statue inside this plaza at Crickets Avenue and 19th Street.
cards.source_title: Buddy Holly Center | City of Lubbock
cards.access_notes: The City states that the plaza is open to the public from dawn to dusk year round.

cards.title: Cast Iron Grill
cards.subtitle: 19th Street corridor near Avenue K
cards.notes: Plan a daytime stop at 620 19th Street for the restaurant’s listed breakfast service or lunch service before the 2 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A daytime dining stop directly on 19th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Cast Iron Grill lists its address as 620 19th Street and states that it serves breakfast Monday through Friday from 7 a.m. and lunch until 2 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The business lists weekday breakfast from 7 a.m. to about 10:30 a.m. and lunch until 2 p.m.

cards.title: McDonald's at 2339 19th Street
cards.subtitle: 19th Street corridor near University Avenue
cards.notes: Use the official restaurant locator to confirm this named 19th Street location when you need a straightforward meal stop near campus.
cards.short_summary: A directly listed restaurant location on the campus-edge corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official Lubbock restaurant directory lists a location at 2339 19th Street.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current service details through the official locator before leaving.

cards.title: Café J
cards.subtitle: 19th Street corridor near University Avenue
cards.notes: Choose from the restaurant’s published brunch, lunch, or dinner menus at its 2605 19th Street address; reserve ahead if desired.
cards.short_summary: A menu-based restaurant stop a short way west of the campus edge.
cards.evidence_claim: Café J’s official site lists its Lubbock address as 2605 19th Street and publishes brunch, lunch, and dinner menus.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists dining hours and a reservation link; check them before visiting.

cards.title: Schlotzsky's Deli 19th St
cards.subtitle: 19th Street corridor near Quaker Avenue
cards.notes: Stop at the official 3715 19th Street location for the listed sandwiches, pizzas, flatbreads, and salads menu categories.
cards.short_summary: A direct-chain location with its address, offerings, and hours published online.
cards.evidence_claim: Schlotzsky’s identifies its 19th Street location at 3715 19th Street and lists sandwiches, pizzas, flatbreads, and salads.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours of 10:30 a.m. to 9 p.m.

cards.title: DoubleDave's Pizzaworks – Lubbock 19th St.
cards.subtitle: 19th Street corridor near Quaker Avenue
cards.notes: Order or dine in at the official 4206 19th Street location, which publishes its daily hours and a location-specific menu link.
cards.short_summary: A pizza restaurant with an official page dedicated to its 19th Street location.
cards.evidence_claim: DoubleDave’s lists its Lubbock 19th Street location at 4206 19th Street, Suite 400, with daily 11 a.m.–10 p.m. hours.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists daily hours from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.

cards.title: Market Street at 19th & Quaker
cards.subtitle: 19th Street corridor at Quaker Avenue
cards.notes: Use this 4425 19th Street grocery stop for in-store shopping or the store’s published DriveUp & Go pickup option at 19th and Quaker.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour grocery destination directly on the western 19th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Market Street’s official page lists the 4425 19th Street store near 19th Street and Quaker Avenue and says it is open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the grocery store as open 24 hours daily; pharmacy hours differ.

cards.title: Bigham's Smokehouse – 19th Street & Quaker
cards.subtitle: 19th Street corridor at Quaker Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the 4302 19th Street restaurant for a sit-down, carry-out, drive-thru, or delivery barbecue meal using its official location information.
cards.short_summary: A named barbecue restaurant on the 19th Street and Quaker block.
cards.evidence_claim: Bigham’s official site lists its 19th Street location at 4302 19th Street and states that its Lubbock locations offer dine-in, carry-out, drive-thru, or delivery.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists 11 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday and Tuesday–Thursday, and 11 a.m.–9 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
